customer_name: Beijing Chaoyang District (北京市朝阳区)
business_problem: Chaoyang District needed a more fine-grained way to understand population movement, congestion, group-housing pressure, and public sentiment because conventional city-management methods could not keep up with the district's dense, diverse, and fast-changing urban environment.
solution_summary: Chaoyang District built its 'Smart Chaoyang' city-management system on Baidu AI Cloud to combine population intelligence, traffic monitoring, and public-opinion analysis in one urban data workflow. Baidu Mingcha uses spatiotemporal population data and user-portrait capabilities to help officials understand migration patterns, industrial layout, and abnormal concentration trends across the district. Those insights are paired with road-traffic monitoring from Baidu Map Huiyan, which shows real-time congestion, average speed, traffic mileage, and early warnings for roads or peak periods. The same city screen also analyzes hot events and search terms so managers can spot public concerns quickly. By connecting population, mobility, traffic, and topic signals, Chaoyang can move from broad administrative management to targeted governance actions such as identifying the densest communities, evaluating market-dispersal efforts, understanding commuting patterns, and improving emergency response with more timely data.

solution_components.name: Baidu Mingcha
solution_components.role: Provides spatiotemporal population analytics and anomaly monitoring for urban-governance decisions.

solution_components.name: Baidu Map Huiyan
solution_components.role: Supplies real-time traffic monitoring and congestion analysis for district-level operations.

solution_components.name: Population Big Data Service Platform
solution_components.role: Presents population trends, alerts, and visualized analysis to city managers for planning and intervention.

data_flow: Population-mobility data and portrait signals feed Baidu Mingcha, while live road conditions and transport indicators enter Huiyan traffic monitoring. The results are visualized together with hot-event analytics so city managers can inspect dense communities, commuting pressure, market-dispersal effects, congestion, and public concerns from one shared governance screen.
business_outcome: Chaoyang gained a more precise and responsive urban-governance operating model, helping officials understand congestion, population pressure, and citizen concerns faster while reducing manual analysis effort.
metrics: The district identified the 30 most densely populated communities.
The system analyzed population changes across 18 markets.
Chaoyang's resident population exceeded 3 million in 2017.
architecture_clues: The system merges population analytics, traffic monitoring, and public-opinion analysis instead of operating each as a separate city dashboard.
Population analysis is tied to group-housing probability and community knowledge-graph modeling for urban management.
Traffic monitoring runs in real time and includes warning functions for roads, incidents, and peak periods.
evidence_quotes: Baidu's Smart Chaoyang system was created to help the district manage population, transport, and public concerns more intelligently (original: 依托于百度智能云技术开发的智慧朝阳由此诞生了).
Baidu Mingcha uses spatiotemporal big data and user portraits to understand population movement and city development (original: 百度明察基于百度时空大数据，并结合用户画像能力，从人口迁徙的视角理解城市布局与产业发展).
The district used community knowledge graphs to identify the 30 most densely populated communities and analyze group-housing risk (original: 结合小区知识图谱，进而精准计算出朝阳区人口密度最高的30个小区、群租房概率和群租指数).
Traffic monitoring on the Huiyan dashboard shows congestion indexes, average speed, and warnings in real time (original: 百度地图慧眼交通监测大屏实时反馈朝阳区交通情况…对道路缓行、拥堵、严重拥堵等路况情况实时监测).
